title: Vegan Earthy Ethiopian Beef Stir-fry
description: This vegan-friendly stir-fry features unsalted beef stock and sous-vide cooking for an earthy, juicy dish that's kid-friendly.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: use firm tofu to mimic the texture of meat

ingredients.name: aubergine (bell pepper)
ingredients.notes: can be roasted or grilled for added depth of flavor

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.notes: or 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger for non-vegan option

instructions: Place the tofu in a bag with unsalted beef stock, seal and cook for about 1 hour.
While the tofu is cooking, slice the aubergine (bell pepper) into thin strips and chop the onion finely. Mince the garlic and ginger.
Heat a large pan over medium heat and add some oil. Sauté the chopped onions until translucent, then add minced garlic and ginger. Stir for about 2 minutes.
Add the sliced aubergine (bell pepper) to the pan and stir-fry for another 5 minutes or until they start to soften.

Drain the tofu from the sous-vide machine and cut into cubes. Add the drained cubes to the aubergine mix, along with spinach, nutritional yeast if using, and some salt & pepper. Stir well to combine all ingredients.
Simmer for about 5 minutes until all vegetables are soft but not mushy. Adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve the stir-fry hot garnished with sesame seeds.
